text: あいつら　しまで　まってる　とかいって　だれも　いねー　じゃねーか！

structure.jp: しまで　まってる　とかいって
structure.en: said they'd be waiting on the island or something

structure.jp: だれも　いねー　じゃねーか！

patterns.name: 〜ではないか
patterns.span: いねー　じゃねーか
patterns.explanation: じゃねーか is a rough form of ではないか, used to point out something angrily, like 'isn't it so!'. いねー is rough for いない. だれもいねーじゃねーか = 'there's nobody here, is there!'

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.explanation: とか before いう repeats what someone said in a vague, dismissive way. まってるとかいって = 'saying they'd wait or whatever'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, which says an action is going on. まってる = 'are waiting'.
